fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on gallons expected to be consumed in 2016, for every one cent increase in the cost of a gallon of jet fuel, our fuel expense would increase by approximately $2.4 million, excluding the results of our fuel hedge program.

instrument_type_details.notes: Heating oil puts and swaps. Not designated as ASC 815 hedges. FV net liability -$39.5M at Dec 31 2015 (assets $1.06M, liabilities $40.53M). 84,067 thousand gallons covering 35% of projected 2016 fuel requirements, settling by December 2016.

warnings: 84,067 gallons (thousands) from derivative position table in financial notes; 35% pct from item7a text
